results.title: Top Places to Eat in Shibuya! 28 Recommended Gourmet Spots by Budget for 2026 | Japan Travel by NAVITIME - Japan Travel Guides, Transit Search and Itinerary Planner
results.content:
If you want to eat high-quality sushi at a reasonable price in Shibuya, you must visit Umegaoka Sushi no Midori. They pride themselves on fresh seafood sourced from Toyosu Market and generous portions of toppings. It is a popular restaurant that always has a line. Although it is not as cheap as conveyor belt sushi, the cost performance is excellent.

Price Range: Lunch sets from ¥3,000, Dinner from ¥5,000

Recommended Points: [...] For a meal that warms both body and soul, MO-MO-PARADISE (formerly Nabezo) offers all-you-can-eat shabu-shabu and sukiyaki. For a fixed price, you can enjoy 100 minutes of high-quality meat slices, fresh vegetables from the buffet bar, side dishes, and drinks all you can eat and drink. It offers excellent value and is especially suitable for cold days, providing a fun and interactive dining experience.

Price Range: Lunch courses from ¥2,500; dinner courses from ¥3,500 to ¥5,000. [...] The craftsmen of Tsunahachi, a restaurant with a history of over 100 years, fry high-quality ingredients to a golden, crispy finish right before your eyes. The Tempura Set Meal (¥2,970 and up) includes two shrimp, fish, seasonal vegetables, and kakiage (mixed vegetable and seafood fritter). For a more premium experience, the Edomae Set Meal (¥5,500) offers kuruma shrimp and conger eel, and the luxurious Banquet Course (¥6,380) includes 12 pieces of tempura.

Price Range: ¥3,000 to ¥6,000

results.content: Family-friendly restaurant in Shibuya : Shabu Shabu If you are keen on a good quality Kobe Beef and Matsuzaka beef lunch, I recommend making a reservation for Shabu Shabu Tsukada in Shibuya Scramble (the same building as Shibuya Sky.)   It’s a bit of a fancy restaurant but they do welcome kids.  Tsukada serve shabu shabu and sukiyaki, made in a hot pot at your own table.  I recommend budgeting for 3000 yen for lunch or 8000 yen per person for dinner.  This restaurant is entirely non-smoking and [...] This is inside the Shibuya Hikarie building. Like most izakaya in Japan, the idea is that you order lots of little dishes and try lots of little things and then order more as you go, if you wanted to.   This is a wonderful place for adults to try Japanese sake (hot and cold) or lemon sours etc while still dining as a family.
